What the pipeline did and did not write down.

⚠️ **lead_slate** — 0 rows for this repo
No ranking, no rejection reasons. The desk’s judgment is unrecoverable.

⚠️ **edition_repos.headline** — 0/6 populated
The card text this repo actually ran under was not kept.

⚠️ **edition_meta** — 0/6 populated

⚠️ **repo_snapshots coverage** — 2 of 5 predate the last appearance
Some telemetry was captured after the coverage window closed.

⚠️ **editor_picks** — 0 rows
No human or model ever second-guessed these calls on the record.

Section, slot and rank written at publish time — including quick hits, which were previously silent.
